extDescription.message: Send browser downloads to the UDM download manager.
extDescription.description: The extension's description in the browser's extension list and store. UDM is the product name.

downloadWithUdm.description: Context menu item on a link, image, video or audio; also the button shown next to selected text that holds links.

downloadLaterWithUdm.description: Context menu item on a link, image, video or audio: adds it to UDM's queue without starting it.

downloadGalleryWithUdm.description: Context menu item on a page: UDM lists the pictures gallery-dl finds on the page to pick from.

downloadAllLinksWithUdm.description: Context menu item on a page: lists the page's links in UDM to pick from.

downloadSelectedLinksWithUdm.message: Download the selected links with UDM
downloadSelectedLinksWithUdm.description: Context menu item on selected text: lists the links in the selection in UDM to pick from.

udmDisconnected.description: Why the extension is not connected, when the browser gives no reason. Shown as the REASON in statusNotConnectedReason.

captureDownloads.description: Popup checkbox: whether downloads the browser starts go to UDM instead.

captureDownloadsTitle.message: Send downloads the browser starts to UDM

captureInTab.description: Popup checkbox at the top: whether downloads started in the current tab go to UDM, like IDM's toolbar button.

captureInTabTitle.message: Turn capture off to leave this tab's downloads to the browser

captureOffInTab.description: Popup note shown next to captureInTab while capture is off in the current tab.

statusConnected.message: Connected. Downloads you start in the browser go to UDM.
statusConnected.description: Popup status line while connected to UDM with capture on.

statusConnectedCaptureOff.message: Connected. Capture is off, so the browser keeps its own downloads.
statusConnectedCaptureOff.description: Popup status line while connected to UDM with capture off.

statusNotConnected.message: Not connected to UDM. Downloads stay in the browser.
statusNotConnected.description: Popup status line while UDM cannot be reached and no reason is known.

statusNotConnectedReason.message: Not connected to UDM: $REASON$. Downloads stay in the browser.
statusNotConnectedReason.description: Popup status line while UDM cannot be reached. REASON is an error message, often from the browser or UDM in English.

reason.example: Specified native messaging host not found

refreshWaiting.message: Your next download gives $NAME$ a new link.
refreshWaiting.description: Popup line while a download in UDM waits for a new link: the next download the browser starts becomes that link.

stopWaiting.description: Popup button next to refreshWaiting: stop waiting for a new link.

skipNextDownload.description: Popup button: the next download the browser starts stays in the browser instead of going to UDM.

skipNextDownloadTitle.message: Let the next download stay in the browser

dontSkip.description: The skipNextDownload button once pressed: undoes it.

skippingNextDownloadTitle.message: The next download stays in the browser

allLinks.description: Popup button: lists the current page's links in UDM to pick from.

allLinksTitle.message: List this page's links in UDM to pick the ones to download

videoButton.description: Popup checkbox: whether a download button shows over videos playing in web pages.

videoButtonTitle.message: A download button over videos playing in the browser

videoButtonOnSite.description: Popup checkbox next to videoButton: whether the video button shows on the current site.

urlPlaceholder.description: Placeholder of the popup's address field.

download.description: Popup button that sends the pasted address to UDM; also the video button's menu item for a whole video or audio file.

noDownloads.description: Popup download list when it is empty.

stateQueued.description: State of a download in the popup list: waiting in UDM's queue.

stateDownloading.description: State of a download in the popup list.

stateDone.description: State of a download in the popup list: finished.

stateFailed.description: State of a download in the popup list.

stateCanceled.description: State of a download in the popup list.

stateInterrupted.description: State of a download in the popup list: stopped when UDM closed; it can resume.

stateConfirming.description: State of a download in the popup list: UDM's window asks the user something about it (the file name is taken).

stateWaiting.description: State of a download in the popup list: added to UDM without starting it.

threatFound.description: Popup list: the virus scan found a threat in the downloaded file.

retry.description: Popup button on a failed, canceled or interrupted download.

remove.description: Popup button on a download: removes it from UDM's list.

sizeProgress.description: Popup list: how much of a download has arrived, out of its whole size. Both are sizes such as sizeMB.

downloadVideo.description: The button the extension shows over a video playing in a web page; it opens a menu of what to download.

videoButtonHelp.description: Tooltip of the video button's "?", which opens help about it.

videoButtonClose.description: Tooltip of the video button's "x", which hides the button for that video until the page loads again.

lookingForVideo.description: The video button's menu while it asks UDM what the video offers.

subtitles.description: The video button's menu: the label before the subtitle languages a stream offers, each with a checkbox.

videoProtected.message: This video is protected by DRM, so UDM will not download it.
videoProtected.description: The video button's menu for a video with copy protection.

streamProtected.message: Protected by DRM; UDM will not download it.
streamProtected.description: The video button's menu, under a stream with copy protection.

udmNotConnected.message: UDM is not running or not connected.
udmNotConnected.description: The video button's menu when UDM cannot be reached.

noVideoFound.message: No video found yet. Let it play for a moment, then try again.
noVideoFound.description: The video button's menu when the page has not loaded a video the extension recognizes.

sentToUdm.description: The video button's menu after a choice was sent to UDM.

couldNotReachUdm.description: The video button's menu when sending a choice to UDM failed.

hlsStream.description: The video button's menu: heading for a video streamed with HLS (a technical name).

dashStream.description: The video button's menu: heading for a video streamed with MPEG-DASH (a technical name).

hdsStream.description: The video button's menu: heading for a video streamed with Adobe HTTP Dynamic Streaming (a technical name).

youtubeVideo.description: The video button's menu: heading for a YouTube video, which UDM reads with yt-dlp.

facebookVideo.description: The video button's menu: heading for a Facebook video, which UDM reads with yt-dlp.

instagramVideo.description: The video button's menu: heading for an Instagram video, which UDM reads with yt-dlp.

vimeoVideo.description: The video button's menu: heading for a Vimeo video, which UDM reads with yt-dlp.

pageVideo.description: The video button's menu: heading for a video on a page of another site, which UDM read with yt-dlp.

playlistTitled.description: The video button's menu: heading for a playlist or channel UDM read with yt-dlp. TITLE is its name, COUNT how many videos it lists.

playlistVideos.description: The video button's menu: heading for a playlist without a name. COUNT is how many videos it lists.

chooseVideos.description: The video button's menu item that opens UDM's window to tick the playlist's videos to download.

mediaNoAnswer.description: The video button's menu, under a stream UDM gave no details for.

soundOnly.description: The video button's menu item for a stream's sound without the picture. FORMAT is a file format.

videoFileType.description: The video button's menu: heading for a video file. TYPE is its file format.

audioFileType.description: The video button's menu: heading for an audio file. TYPE is its file format.

videoFile.description: The video button's menu: heading for a video file of unknown format.

audioFile.description: The video button's menu: heading for an audio file of unknown format.

takeoverFailed.message: UDM could not take over the download
takeoverFailed.description: Title of the notice shown when UDM could not take a download from the browser, which then downloads it itself.

takeoverNotConnected.message: UDM is not running or not connected, so the browser downloads $FILE$.
takeoverNotConnected.description: Body of the notice when UDM is not running or not connected. FILE is the download's file name or address.

takeoverError.message: UDM could not start $FILE$ ($REASON$), so the browser downloads it.
takeoverError.description: Body of the notice when UDM refused or could not start a download. FILE is the file name or address, REASON is UDM's error message.

dontShowAgain.description: Button on the notice that UDM could not take a download: stop showing such notices.

takeoverClickToStop.message: Click this notice to stop showing it.
takeoverClickToStop.description: Added to the notice in browsers whose notices have no buttons (Firefox): clicking the notice stops such notices.

downloadLastVideo.message: Download the last video with UDM
downloadLastVideo.description: Context menu item on a page or video: sends the video or audio the browser loaded last, in any tab, to UDM.

recentVideos.description: Context menu item on a page or video: a submenu of the last 10 videos or audio files the browser loaded, to send one to UDM.

downloadPageWithUdm.description: Context menu item on a page or frame: sends the address of the page (or the frame clicked in) itself to UDM.

noLinksFound.message: No links found on this page.
noLinksFound.description: Notice when "Download all links with UDM" finds no links on the page.

noSelectedLinksFound.message: No links found in the selection.
noSelectedLinksFound.description: Notice when "Download selected links with UDM" finds no links in the selected text.

linksUnreadable.message: The browser does not let UDM read the links of this page.
linksUnreadable.description: Notice when the extension may not read a page's links (a browser page or the extension store).

cannotReachUdm.message: Cannot reach UDM. Is it running?
cannotReachUdm.description: Notice when a context menu item or button could not send something to UDM.

cannotReachUdmReason.description: Notice when a context menu item or button could not send something to UDM. REASON is the browser's error.

browserDownloadsInstead.description: Added to the "Cannot reach UDM" notice when the browser downloads the link itself.

browserDownloadsHeading.description: Popup heading over the browser's own downloads in progress, which can be sent to UDM.

sendToUdm.description: Popup button next to a download in progress in the browser: cancels it in the browser and downloads it with UDM.
